summary: Project is under active delivery pressure. A long-running payment blocker has already missed its deadline, critical knowledge is concentrated on one engineer, and new high-impact scope is entering without estimates. Quality debt (flaky tests) continues to erode CI confidence.

risks.title: Critical work concentrated on a single person (bus factor = 1)
risks.evidence: Alice is the only assignee on #29 (database migration), #42 (payment blocker), and #55 (profile page). She also owns the only open payment-related PR (#88). No secondary owner is documented for the order schema.
risks.recommended_action: Pair Alice with another engineer this sprint. Document the database schema and payment integration in a short runbook. Reassign at least one high-priority item.

risks.title: Payment gateway blocked for 20+ days — past due date
risks.evidence: Issue #42 labeled blocker + high-priority. Created 2026-07-10, due 2026-07-25 (missed). 8 comments still waiting on production API keys from the provider. Checkout flow cannot ship without it.
risks.recommended_action: Escalate to the payment provider account manager today. In parallel, implement a sandbox/mock path so frontend and QA work is unblocked.

risks.title: New Black Friday discount engine added without estimate
risks.evidence: Issue #51 created 2026-07-27 with label unestimated, no assignee, and no acceptance criteria. Marketing wants a completely new rules engine. Risk of late scope creep into the release.
risks.recommended_action: Run a 30-minute estimation session this week. Decide: in-scope for current release, deferred, or split into a minimal viable version.

risks.title: Flaky checkout tests open for 25 days
risks.evidence: Issue #38 (flaky tests in checkout suite) created 2026-07-05, due 2026-07-15 (missed). 12 comments. Random CI failures reduce trust in the pipeline and slow merges.
risks.recommended_action: Quarantine the flaky tests immediately so they stop blocking PRs. Schedule a focused bug-bash or rewrite the unstable assertions.

risks.title: Database migration for new order schema still open past deadline
risks.evidence: Issue #29 labeled backend + high-priority + database. Created 2026-07-01, due 2026-07-20 (missed). 15 comments. Required before the new order flow can ship. Only Alice understands the old schema.
risks.recommended_action: Treat as a release-blocking item. Pair for knowledge transfer and set a hard completion date within the next 5 business days.

risks.title: WIP payment PR has been open 12 days with little progress
risks.evidence: PR #88 (WIP: Payment provider sandbox integration) opened 2026-07-18, last update 2026-07-28. Labeled wip. Linked to the same blocked payment workstream.
risks.recommended_action: Either convert to a draft with clear remaining tasks or close and re-open when unblocked. Post a short status update on the related issue.

positive_signals: Team is actively updating issues (several touches in the last few days)
Most tickets have clear labels (blocker, high-priority, bug, feature)
Frontend work (#55) is progressing and is not blocked
Demo data path ensures the radar always produces a useful report even on empty repos
trend_explanation: Two high-priority items have already missed their due dates, a critical knowledge silo remains, and new unestimated scope is entering. Without intervention this week, release confidence will drop further.
next_steps: Escalate payment provider blocker and create a temporary mock path (today)
Reduce bus-factor risk on Alice — pair + document schema (this week)
Estimate or defer the Black Friday discount engine (this week)
Quarantine flaky checkout tests so CI is trustworthy again
Set a hard date for the database migration and treat it as release-blocking
